name: sp-with-radar-cross-section-to-asterix-cat062-drops-sp
source: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-9 Edition 1.21, UAP (FRN 35 SP) and the SP item structure; IEEE 754 single for 0.25 is 3E800000; built by hand from asterix-cat062 vector 15
reference: asterix-cat062 does not map I062/SP, so the same entity written with it has no SP: the opt-in is the choice of format.
